title: Salmon Croquettes
blurb: Quick pan-fried patties made with tinned salmon, bound with egg white and cornflour, seasoned simply and cooked until golden.
steps: Place the drained salmon in a bowl and flake it with a fork, removing any large bones or skin.
Add the egg white, cornflour, salt and pepper to the salmon and mix until everything comes together into a sticky mixture.
Divide the mixture into four portions and shape each into a round patty about 2cm thick.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the patties and cook for 6 to 7 minutes on each side until golden brown and firm to the touch.
Drain briefly on kitchen paper before serving.
